source_refs.note: Roman Urdu solution of the Chapter 7 exercise (PDF 191-193, key PDF 226): MCQs with key and reason, short and long answers, Wazahat boxes where needed.

blocks.text: Is exercise mein 10 multiple-choice sawal (MCQs), 8 short (mukhtasar) aur 5 long (tafseeli) sawal hain. Har MCQ ka sahi jawab aur us ki wajah chapter ke text se di gayi hai; jahan kitab ki answer key ghalat hai wahan "Kitab ki ghalti" box hai. Short aur long sawalon ke jawab imtihan ke andaz mein hain: pehle seedhi definition, phir kitab ke points, phir misal.

blocks.prompt:
1. Which of the following is NOT typically included in the common clauses of Terms of Use?
(In mein se kaunsi cheez aam taur par Terms of Use ki common clauses (aam shartein) mein shamil NAHI hoti?)
blocks.explanation: Product advertising Terms of Use ki common clauses mein shamil nahi. Kitab (7.1.2) paanch clauses batati hai: User Obligations, Limitations of Liability, Privacy and Data Use, Intellectual Property Rights aur Termination of Service.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki key (safha 223) (b) Privacy and data use deti hai. Lekin Privacy and Data Use to 7.1.2 ki list mein shamil clause hai; jo shamil NAHI woh (c) Product advertising hai. Kitab mein option (c) ka label bhi “©” chhapa hai.

blocks.prompt:
2. What does the “Limitations of Liability” clause in Terms of Use usually do?
(Terms of Use mein “Limitations of Liability” clause aam taur par kya karti hai?)

options.text: Ensures the company takes full responsibility for all issues
Limits the company's liability if things go wrong
Provides user rights for any damages
Guarantees service availability at all times

blocks.explanation: 7.1.2 ke mutabiq Limitations of Liability clause kuch ghalat hone par provider ki liability (zimmedari) mehdood karti hai, maslan bank ki app thori der band ho jaye to bank poori zimmedari nahi leta.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Key (a) deti hai: “company har masle ki poori zimmedari leti hai”. Yeh is clause ka ulat hai; text kehta hai yeh zimmedari ko limit karti hai, is liye sahi jawab (b) hai.

blocks.prompt:
3. Which of the following is a harmful software that secretly monitors your computer or phone activities?
(In mein se kaunsa harmful (nuqsan pohanchane wala) software chupke se aap ke computer ya phone ki activities ko monitor karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Spyware woh harmful (nuqsan dene wala) software hai jo chupke se aap ke computer ya phone par aap ki activities dekhta hai (7.2.1.2). Spam sirf unwanted messages hain, software nahi.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Key (a) Spam deti hai. Spam to ghair-zaroori messages hain (7.2.1.1), monitor karne wala software nahi; text ke mutabiq yeh kaam spyware karta hai, is liye jawab (c) hai.

blocks.prompt:
4. Which of the following threats involves redirecting users to fake websites without their knowledge?
(Kaunsa khatra user ko us ke ilm ke baghair jaali websites par bhej deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pharming mein user ko us ke ilm ke baghair asal website ki jagah jaali (fake) website par bhej diya jata hai. Phishing mein dhoka dene wala message bheja jata hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Key (c) Spyware deti hai. Spyware sirf nigrani karta hai; jaali website par bhejna pharming ka kaam hai, is liye jawab (d) hai.

blocks.prompt:
5. How does the digital divide affect education?
(Digital divide taleem par kaise asar dalta hai?)

options.text: It improves learning for all students
It has no impact on education
It creates inequality in access to digital learning resources
It makes traditional teaching methods obsolete

blocks.explanation: Digital divide ki wajah se digital learning resources tak pohanch barabar nahi rehti: jin students ke paas internet ya device nahi woh peeche reh jate hain, jaise COVID-19 mein online classes ke dauran hua (7.3.2.1).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Key (b) “taleem par koi asar nahi” deti hai. Text (7.3.2.1) kehta hai ke aise students bohat nuqsan mein rehte hain aur taleemi farq barh gaya, is liye jawab (c) hai.

blocks.prompt:
6. What does data provenance refer to?
(Data provenance ka kya matlab hai?)

options.text: The cost of accessing the information.
The history and origins of the data.
The popularity of the information source.
The translation of information into multiple languages.

blocks.explanation: Data provenance ka matlab data ki history hai: woh kahan se aaya aur us mein kya tabdeeli hui (7.4.1.3).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Key (c) “source ki popularity” deti hai. Text data provenance ko data ki history aur origin kehta hai, is liye jawab (b) hai.

blocks.prompt:
7. Why is understanding bias important when evaluating information?
(Maloomat parakhte waqt bias samajhna kyun zaroori hai?)

options.text: To recognize and account for a source's viewpoint or agenda.
To validate all sources as equally reliable.
To avoid evaluating the information altogether.

blocks.explanation: Bias samajhne ka matlab hai yeh pehchanna ke har source ka apna nazariya ya agenda ho sakta hai, is liye kai viewpoints dekh kar check karein ke baat insaf se pesh hui hai (7.4.1.7).

blocks.prompt:
8. Which of the following is a positive impact of computing systems on society?
(In mein se society (muashre) par computing systems ka positive (achha) asar kaunsa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Computing ka sab se bara positive asar maloomat tak asaan pohanch hai (7.5.1). Baqi teen options manfi (negative) asraat hain (7.5.2).

blocks.prompt:
9. What does ethical use of information involve?
(Maloomat ke ethical istemal mein kya shamil hai?)

options.text: Ignoring data sources when sharing information.

blocks.explanation: Maloomat ka ethical (akhlaqi) istemal yani data ko insaf aur qanoon ke mutabiq istemal karna: copyright ki izzat aur asal likhne wale ko credit de kar plagiarism (doosre ka kaam apna banana) se bachna (7.6.2.2).

blocks.prompt:
10. Which of the following is NOT a sign of responsible digital behavior?
(In mein se kaunsa kaam responsible digital behavior (zimmedari wala rawayya) NAHI?)

options.text: Using secure websites for personal data sharing.
Spreading false information on social media.

blocks.explanation: Jhooti maloomat phailana ghair-zimmedarana hai; digital citizenship ka matlab hai izzat se baat karna aur jhooti maloomat na phailana (7.6). Baqi teen kaam zimmedari wale hain.

blocks.prompt:
1. Why is it important for users to understand Terms of Use?
(Users ke liye Terms of Use samajhna kyun zaroori hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Terms of Use woh legal agreements (qanooni muahide) hain jo batate hain ke service ya product kaise istemal hoga; user ko inhein manna parta hai.
Yeh user ke rights ki hifazat karte hain, jaise privacy aur kuch ghalat ho to redress (izala) ka haq.
Provider kya dega aur kya mana hai, yeh saaf ho jata hai, is liye user soch samajh kar faisla karta hai.
In se qanooni masle, jaise jurmana ya service se ban, se bachao hota hai.

blocks.prompt:
2. Differentiate between phishing and pharming.
(Phishing aur pharming mein farq bataiye.)
blocks.explanation: Phishing mein jaali message aap ko dhoka de kar maloomat nikalwata hai; pharming mein sahi address likhne par bhi aap ko chupke se jaali website par bhej diya jata hai.

rows: Bharose wala idara ban kar jaali email ya message bhejna
User ko us ke ilm ke baghair jaali website par bhej dena
User khud dhoke mein aa kar click ya jawab karta hai
Sahi address likhne par bhi ho jata hai
Maqsad: aap se personal maloomat nikalwana
Maqsad: asal site ki naqal par aap ki maloomat lena
Misal: account details maangne wali bank jaisi jaali email
Misal: bank ka sahi URL likhne par naqli site khulna

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text:
Phishing mein chara (bait) aap ko bheja jata hai aur aap khud click karte hain; pharming mein rasta hi badal diya jata hai.
Pharming se bachne ke liye address bar mein https aur tala (padlock) zaroor dekhein.

blocks.prompt:
3. Describe how cookies can be both beneficial and invasive to privacy. Give an example of each scenario.
(Cookies privacy ke liye faidemand bhi aur dakhal dene wali bhi kaise hain? Har ek ki misal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Cookies choti files hain jo website aap ke device par rakhti hai: yeh aap ko yaad rakh kar madad karti hain, magar aap ko track bhi kar sakti hain.

rows: Aap ko logged in rakhti hain
Aap ke dekhe hue pages aur products track karti hain
Aap ki preferences (pasand) save rakhti hain
Usi record se milte julte ads dikhati hain
Misal: shopping site aap ka login yaad rakhti hai
Misal: joote dekhne ke baad har jagah jooton ke ads

blocks.prompt:
4. Identify two impacts of the digital divide on social and civic participation.
(Social aur civic participation par digital divide ke do asar bataiye.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Log be-khabar aur door reh jate hain: access na ho to social media, online news aur digital government services se mehroom rehte hain.
2. Aise log democratic processes (jamhoori amal) aur e-government services mein kam hissa lete hain, jaise Pakistan ke dehi (rural) log.

blocks.prompt:
5. What are the key steps involved in evaluating information sources?
(Information sources parakhne ke zaroori qadam (steps) kya hain?)
blocks.explanation:
Sources parakhne ka matlab hai check karna ke maloomat sahi aur bharose ke qabil hai. Aham qadam:
1. Source aur us ki credibility (saakh) dekhein: kya expert ya authority se hai? (chand ki khabar Hilal Committee se)
2. Data provenance (data ki history) dekhein aur primary (asal) sources ko tarjeeh dein.
3. Critical thinking (tanqeedi soch) karein: red flags (author na ho, sansani headline, references na hon) aur bias pehchanein.

blocks.prompt:
6. Explain how computing systems have impacted communication in society.
(Computing systems ne society (muashre) mein communication par kya asar dala?)
blocks.explanation:
Computing systems ne communication (rabta) ko tez aur asaan bana kar logon ko duniya bhar se jor diya.
Social media (Facebook, X) se log rabte mein rehte hain aur aagahi aur social movements phailti hain.
Daraz jaise e-commerce platforms se karobar mulk bhar ke customers tak pohanchte hain.
Magar ghalat maloomat aur fake news bhi tezi se phailti hai, jaise COVID-19 ke baare mein.

blocks.prompt:
7. How does responsible data sharing contribute to ethical use of information?
(Responsible data sharing maloomat ke ethical istemal mein kaise madad karti hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Responsible data sharing yani personal ya sensitive (hassas) maloomat sirf zaroorat par aur sirf bharose wale idaron ko dena.
Is se privacy bachti hai aur maloomat ka ghalat istemal nahi hota.
Doosron ke rights ki izzat hoti hai: kisi ka data us ki ijazat ke baghair share nahi hota.
Misal: student scholarship ke liye details sirf secure aur verified website par deta hai.

blocks.prompt:
8. Describe two ways to recognize online threats and prevent cybersecurity risks.
(Online khatre pehchanne aur cybersecurity ke khatron se bachne ke do tareeqe bataiye.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Phishing pehchanein: "fori zaroorat" wali email jo personal details maange us se hoshiyar rahein; shak wale link par click na karein aur bhejne wale ki tasdeeq karein.
2. Malware se bachein: ghair-bharose wali jagah se software download na karein aur antivirus update rakhein.

blocks.prompt:
1. Explain the common clauses found in Terms of Use and describe how they protect both the service provider and the user.
(Terms of Use ki common clauses samjhaiye aur bataiye ke yeh provider aur user dono ko kaise bachati hain.)
blocks.explanation:
Terms of Use (Terms and Conditions / Terms of Service) provider ke banaye hue legal agreements hain jo batate hain ke service ya product kaise istemal hoga. In ki common clauses provider aur user dono ki hifazat ke liye hoti hain (7.1.2):
1. User Obligations (user ki zimmedariyan): user se kya umeed hai. Misal: Careem valid phone number mangta hai aur service ko transport ke ilawa kisi kaam ke liye istemal mana karta hai.
Provider ko ghalat istemal se bachati hai; doosre users ke liye service mehfooz rehti hai.
2. Limitations of Liability: kuch ghalat ho to provider ki zimmedari mehdood karti hai. Misal: bank ki app thori der band ho to bank ki zimmedari limited hoti hai.
Provider ko na-jaiz daawon se bachati hai; user ko saaf pata hota hai ke provider kis baat ka zimmedar hai aur kis ka nahi.
3. Privacy and Data Use: company user ka data kaise jama, istemal aur mehfooz karti hai. Misal: WhatsApp ki terms batati hain ke messages kaise store aur protect hote hain.
User ki privacy bachati hai; provider ko jawabdeh banati hai.
4. Intellectual Property Rights: provider ke logo, software aur material ki hifazat. Misal: Pakistani news website ijazat ke baghair articles copy karna mana karti hai.
Provider ka kaam chori hone se bachta hai; user ko pata hota hai kya dobara istemal kar sakta hai.
5. Termination of Service: provider kab user ka account band kar sakta hai. Misal: Facebook nafrat angez baatein ya ghalat maloomat phailane wale accounts band kar deta hai.
Provider aur community nuqsan dene wale users se bachte hain; user ko pehle se pata hota hai ke kis baat par account band hoga.
Dono ki hifazat kaise:
- Provider: qawaid aur hudood banti hain, qanooni khatra kam hota hai, us ki property bachti hai (legal safeguards).
- User: rights (privacy, maloomat, izala) wazeh hote hain, clarity aur transparency milti hai, aur woh soch samajh kar faisla karta hai.
Is tarah dono ke darmiyan insaf wala aur saaf rishta banta hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Terms of Use ko aik muahida (agreement) samjhein jaise ghar kiraye par lete waqt hota hai: maalik batata hai ke kiraya kab dena hai (user obligations), toot phoot ki kitni zimmedari us ki hai (liability), woh aap ki zaati cheezon ko haath nahi lagayega (privacy), ghar ka naqsha us ka hai (intellectual property), aur qawaid todne par ghar khali karwa sakta hai (termination). Imtihan mein har clause ke saath (1) matlab, (2) misal aur (3) kis ki hifazat karti hai likhein, poore number milenge.

blocks.prompt:
2. Explain the concept of bridging the digital divide and discuss the roles of government initiatives in addressing this issue. Provide relevant examples from Pakistan.
(Digital divide ko bridge karne ka concept (bunyadi khayal) samjhaiye aur is masle mein government initiatives ka role bataiye, Pakistan ki misalon ke saath.)
blocks.explanation:
Digital divide un logon, ilaqon aur khitton ke darmiyan farq hai jin ke paas jadeed ICT (information and communication technology) hai aur jin ke paas nahi (7.3). Digital divide ko bridge karne (khala bharne) ka matlab hai ke har kisi ko technology aur internet tak barabar pohanch mile, taake sab ko seekhne aur aage barhne ke barabar mauqe milein (7.3.3).
Kyun zaroori: is farq se taleem, rozgar, sehat aur social participation mein na-barabari paida hoti hai. Is ki wajahein: maali (device ya broadband ki qeemat), jughrafiyai (dehi ilaqon mein infrastructure nahi), taleemi (digital literacy ki kami) aur samaji (umar, gender, disability).
Bridge karne ke tareeqe:
1. Government initiatives (hukoomati iqdamaat): jahan internet nahi wahan infrastructure banana.
2. Educational programs: school aur community centers logon ko computer aur internet chalana sikhayein.
3. Public-private partnerships: hukoomat, karobar aur nonprofits mil kar technology sasti karein.
Government ka kirdar, Pakistan ki misalein:
- Door daraz ilaqon mein infrastructure: Universal Service Fund (USF) gaon aur door ilaqon tak internet pohanchata hai.
- Mobile broadband: hukoomat ne door ilaqon mein mobile broadband services shuru ki hain.
- Digital literacy aur e-services: hukoomati programs aur e-government services logon ko digital skills aur online services deti hain; "Internet in a Box" jaise offline projects ne internet ke baghair ilaqon tak digital learning pohanchayi.
- Private sector ke saath kaam: partnerships se devices aur connection saste hote hain.
In koshishon ke bawajood bohat se ilaqon mein ab bhi achha internet nahi, is liye yeh kaam abhi jari hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Digital divide ko aik darya samjhein: aik kinare par woh log jin ke paas mobile, computer aur internet hai, doosre kinare par woh jin ke paas nahi. "Bridge" yani pul banana. Hukoomat pul ke sutoon banati hai (USF ke zariye gaon tak internet, mobile broadband), schools logon ko pul par chalna sikhate hain (digital literacy), aur private companies pul ka kiraya kam karti hain (sasti technology). Jawab mein pehle definition, phir wajahein, phir teen tareeqe aur Pakistan ki misalein likhein.

blocks.prompt:
3. Explain how critical thinking skills contribute to responsible information utilization. Provide examples of how these skills can be applied in real-life scenarios.
(Critical thinking skills maloomat ke zimmedari wale istemal mein kaise madad deti hain? Asal zindagi ki misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation:
Critical thinking skills (tanqeedi soch) woh salahiyat hai jis se hum maloomat ko parakhte hain: maloomat par sawal uthana, mukhtalif nazariye dekhna aur soch samajh kar faisla karna (7.4.1.5).
Yeh zimmedari se maloomat istemal karne mein kaise madad deti hain:
1. Source check: maloomat kahan se aayi? Official government websites jaise reliable sources ko tarjeeh.
2. Credibility check: kya likhne wala us topic ka expert ya authority hai?
3. Data provenance aur primary sources: data ka asal, us mein tabdeeli, aur asal material dekhna.
4. Red flags pehchanna: author ka naam na hona, sansani khez headlines, references na hona.
5. Bias pehchanna: kai viewpoints mila kar dekhna ke baat insaf se pesh hui.
6. Ghalat maloomat se bachao: yaqeen ya share karne se pehle tasdeeq, taake fake news na phaile aur ghalat faisle na hon.
Asal zindagi ki misalein:
- Nayi technology: kisi naye gadget par raaye banane se pehle sirf aik ad nahi, kai sources aur viewpoints parhein.
- Eid ka chand: social media ki ghair-tasdeeq posts ke bajaye official Hilal Committee ka elaan manein.
- Sehat ki afwahen: COVID-19 mein virus aur vaccine ke baare mein jhooti baatein phailin; samajhdar shakhs share karne se pehle official health sources dekhta hai.
- News: jo website sirf aik taraf ki baat kare woh biased ho sakti hai; doosre idaron se milayein.
- Jis website par author ya contact maloomat na ho, use school report mein istemal na karein.
- Scholarship ya bank ka message jo personal details maange, jawab se pehle us ki tasdeeq karein.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Critical thinking ka asaan formula: "Kaun keh raha hai? Kaise pata? Doosre kya kehte hain? Phir faisla." Jab WhatsApp par koi khabar aaye to pehle source dekhein, phir kisi bharose wale idare (jaise government website ya Hilal Committee) se milayein, aur tasdeeq ke baghair forward na karein. Yahi responsible information utilization hai.

blocks.prompt:
4. Discuss the importance of collaborative problem solving in a digital environment and provide examples of how human-machine collaboration can enhance this process.
(Digital mahaul mein mil kar masle hal karne ki ahmiyat bataiye aur misalon se samjhaiye ke human-machine collaboration ise kaise behtar banata hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Collaborative problem solving ka matlab hai doosron ke saath mil kar mushkilat hal karna aur mushtarka maqasid (common goals) hasil karna (7.6.4).
Digital mahaul mein ahmiyat:
1. Sab ki khoobiyan jurti hain: har member apni maharat deta hai, nateeja akele kaam se behtar hota hai.
2. Teamwork aur knowledge sharing: group project mein members apni research share karte hain; study groups aur discussions se sab ki samajh barhti hai (7.6.4.2).
3. Mushkil masail ke behtar hal: mukhtalif nazariye milte hain, aur digital tools se log alag jagah hote hue bhi aik kaam par mil kar kaam kar sakte hain.
4. Seekhna aur zimmedari: members aik doosre se seekhte hain aur nateeje ki mil kar zimmedari lete hain.
Human-machine collaboration yani technology ke saath mil kar masle hal karna (7.6.4.1). Yeh do tarah madad karta hai:
1. Tools ka istemal: software aur digital tools kaam mein madad dete hain. Misal: students group project ka data spreadsheet software mein analyze karte hain, hisaab aur charts jaldi aur durust bante hain.
2. Skills ko jorna: insaani salahiyat aur machine ki taqat mila kar behtar nateeja. Misal: data analysis tools mushkil data process karte hain, aur insaan apni samajh (judgement) se nateeja samajh kar faisla karta hai.
Yani machine raftar aur durusti deti hai, insaan creativity, faisla aur teamwork; dono mil kar akele se behtar masle hal karte hain.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Misal se samjhein: science project mein aap ka group pani ki safai ka data jama karta hai. Spreadsheet (machine) sekandon mein average aur graph bana deti hai, lekin yeh faisla ke kaunsa ilaqa sab se zyada khatre mein hai aur kya hal ho, group ke insaan mil kar karte hain. Yahi human-machine collaboration hai.

blocks.prompt:
5. Explain the concept of creating accessible digital content and describe strategies to ensure digital inclusivity for individuals with disabilities.
(Accessible digital content ka concept samjhaiye aur disabled (maazoor) logon ki digital inclusivity (sab ko shamil karna) ke strategies (tareeqe) bataiye.)
blocks.explanation:
Accessible digital content ka matlab hai aisa content banana jo har koi istemal kar sake, disabled (maazoor) log bhi (7.6.5). Digital inclusivity yani koi bhi digital content se mehroom na rahe.
Inclusivity ke strategies (tareeqe):
1. Design for accessibility (7.6.5.1):
- Readable fonts: saaf aur bare fonts jo asaani se parhe jayein. Misal: Arial ya Times New Roman, zyada sajawat wale fonts nahi.
- Images ke liye alternative text: tasveer ki tafseel likhein taake nazar se mazoor log samajh sakein (screen reader yeh text bol kar sunata hai). Misal: report ke charts aur graphs ki wazahat likhna.
2. User feedback (7.6.5.2):
- Surveys aur forms: content par raaye le kar behtari karein. Misal: website bana kar users se tajurba poochein aur tabdeeli karein.
- Direct communication: users se baat kar ke un ki zaroorat samjhein. Misal: presentation par classmates ki raaye le kar behtar banayein.
Mazeed tareeqe (beyond the chapter, yani kitab se bahar): videos par captions ya transcript (behre logon ke liye); rangon ka achha contrast; keyboard aur screen reader se chalne wala content; saada zaban.
Accessible content se disabled logon ko taleem, maloomat aur services tak barabar pohanch milti hai, aur yeh achhi digital citizenship ka hissa hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Sochein aap ki class mein aik student ki nazar kamzor hai. Agar slides par bare, saaf fonts hon aur har chart ke neeche likha ho ke chart kya dikhata hai (alt text), to woh bhi screen reader ya magnifier se sab samajh lega. Phir aap us se poochein ke kya mushkil hui (feedback) aur slides behtar karein. Accessibility ka yahi matlab hai: content sab ke liye.
